name: Stay Believable
description: Keep your position feeling intentional from start to finish.
goal: Do not become too easy for the room to place.
hint: A line can steady you. It can also begin to glow.

name: Avoid The Early Center
description: Stay out of the room's center before pressure peaks.
hint: If the room settles on you too early, it is hard to leave.

name: Keep It Unsettled
description: You benefit if the room never fully closes around one read.
goal: Reach the end with no truly stable center.
hint: A split room can still feel believable.

name: Invite Movement
description: You benefit when more than one person has to reconsider.
goal: Leave the room with visible revisions in the air.
hint: If nobody moves, everyone becomes easier to place.

name: Stay Hard To Place
description: Do not let the room settle too cleanly around you.
goal: Remain difficult to read through the end.
hint: Unreadable is not absent. It is unresolved.

name: Carry Scrutiny
description: If attention lands on you, carry it without hardening.
hint: The room watches how you hold pressure, not just whether you face it.

name: Let The Room Move First
description: You benefit when the room shifts around you before you shift yourself.
goal: Stay just outside the center while the room keeps moving.
hint: Sometimes the safest place is near the center, but not inside it.

name: Turn Without Breaking
description: If you move, the move still has to feel earned.
goal: Make a late turn that still feels believable.
hint: A visible turn can steady you or expose you.
